content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository pulp-platform_axi_pr245, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# Tie mst_w_chan to '0 when mst_w_valid!=0.
https://github.com/pulp-platform/axi/blob/64ca21eb2ffcc26ed9b7635d19723fa227f38699/src/axi_lite_mux.sv#L286
The muxes seem redundant. Is it on purpose?
If not, we can remove the muxes, right?
`assign mst_w_chan      =  slv_reqs_i[w_select].w;`

Here is the project file that may be relevant to this issue:

30   parameter type         w_chan_t       = logic,

45   parameter bit          SpillR         = 1'b0,
46   // Dependent parameters, DO NOT OVERRIDE!
47   parameter int unsigned SelectWidth    = (NoMstPorts > 32'd1) ? $clog2(NoMstPorts) : 32'd1,
48   parameter type         select_t       = logic [SelectWidth-1:0]
49 ) (
50   input  logic                          clk_i,
51   input  logic                          rst_ni,
52   input  logic                          test_i,
53   // Slave Port

113       .data_i  ( mst_resps_i[0].b       ),
114       .valid_o ( slv_resp_o.b_valid     ),
115       .ready_i ( slv_req_i.b_ready      ),

121     ) i_ar_spill_reg (

124       .valid_i ( slv_req_i.ar_valid       ),
125       .ready_o ( slv_resp_o.ar_ready      ),

127       .valid_o ( mst_reqs_o[0].ar_valid   ),
128       .ready_i ( mst_resps_i[0].ar_ready  ),

133       .Bypass  ( ~SpillR      )
134     ) i_r_spill_reg (
135       .clk_i   ( clk_i                  ),
136       .rst_ni  ( rst_ni                 ),
137       .valid_i ( mst_resps_i[0].r_valid ),
138       .ready_o ( mst_reqs_o[0].r_ready  ),
139       .data_i  ( mst_resps_i[0].r       ),

146   end else begin : gen_demux
147 
148     //--------------------------------------
149     //--------------------------------------
150     // Signal Declarations
151     //--------------------------------------
152     //--------------------------------------
153 
154     //--------------------------------------
155     // Write Transaction
156     //--------------------------------------
157     // comes from spill register at input
158     aw_chan_select_t          slv_aw_chan_select;
159     logic                     slv_aw_valid,       slv_aw_ready;
160 
161     // AW ID counter
162     select_t                  lookup_aw_select;
163     logic                     aw_select_occupied, aw_id_cnt_full;
164     logic                     aw_push;
165     // Upon an ATOP load, inject IDs from the AW into the AR channel
166     logic                     atop_inject;
167 
168     // W FIFO: stores the decision to which master W beats should go
169     logic                     w_fifo_pop;
170     logic                     w_fifo_full,        w_fifo_empty;
171     select_t                  w_select;
172 
173     // Register which locks the AW valid signal
174     logic                     lock_aw_valid_d,    lock_aw_valid_q, load_aw_lock;
175     logic                     aw_valid,           aw_ready;
176 
177     // W channel from spill reg
178     w_chan_t                  slv_w_chan;
179     logic                     slv_w_valid,        slv_w_ready;
180 
181     // B channles input into the arbitration
182     b_chan_t [NoMstPorts-1:0] mst_b_chans;
183     logic    [NoMstPorts-1:0] mst_b_valids,       mst_b_readies;
184 
185     // B channel to spill register
186     b_chan_t                  slv_b_chan;
187     logic                     slv_b_valid,        slv_b_ready;
188 
189     //--------------------------------------
190     // Read Transaction
191     //--------------------------------------
192     // comes from spill register at input
193     ar_chan_select_t          slv_ar_chan_select;
194     logic                     slv_ar_valid,       slv_ar_ready;
195 
196     // AR ID counter
197     select_t                  lookup_ar_select;
198     logic                     ar_select_occupied, ar_id_cnt_full;
199     logic                     ar_push;
200 
201     // Register which locks the AR valid signel
202     logic                     lock_ar_valid_d,    lock_ar_valid_q, load_ar_lock;
203     logic                     ar_valid,           ar_ready;
204 
205     // R channles input into the arbitration
206     r_chan_t [NoMstPorts-1:0] mst_r_chans;
207     logic    [NoMstPorts-1:0] mst_r_valids, mst_r_readies;
208 
209     // R channel to spill register
210     r_chan_t                  slv_r_chan;
211     logic                     slv_r_valid,        slv_r_ready;
212 
213     //--------------------------------------
214     //--------------------------------------
215     // Channel Control
216     //--------------------------------------
217     //--------------------------------------
218 
219     //--------------------------------------
220     // AW Channel
221     //--------------------------------------
222     // spill register at the channel input
223     `ifdef TARGET_VSIM
224     // Workaround for bug in Questa 2020.2 and 2021.1: Flatten the struct into a logic vector before
225     // instantiating `spill_register`.
226     typedef logic [$bits(aw_chan_select_t)-1:0] aw_chan_select_flat_t;
227     `else
228     // Other tools, such as VCS, have problems with `$bits()`, so the workaround cannot be used
229     // generally.
230     typedef aw_chan_select_t aw_chan_select_flat_t;
231     `endif
232     aw_chan_select_flat_t slv_aw_chan_select_in_flat,
233                           slv_aw_chan_select_out_flat;
234     assign slv_aw_chan_select_in_flat = {slv_req_i.aw, slv_aw_select_i};
235     spill_register #(
236       .T       ( aw_chan_select_flat_t        ),
237       .Bypass  ( ~SpillAw                     ) // because module param indicates if we want a spill reg
238     ) i_aw_spill_reg (
239       .clk_i   ( clk_i                        ),
240       .rst_ni  ( rst_ni                       ),
241       .valid_i ( slv_req_i.aw_valid           ),
242       .ready_o ( slv_resp_o.aw_ready          ),
243       .data_i  ( slv_aw_chan_select_in_flat   ),
244       .valid_o ( slv_aw_valid                 ),
245       .ready_i ( slv_aw_ready                 ),
246       .data_o  ( slv_aw_chan_select_out_flat  )
247     );
248     assign slv_aw_chan_select = slv_aw_chan_select_out_flat;
249 
250     // Control of the AW handshake
251     always_comb begin
252       // AXI Handshakes
253       slv_aw_ready = 1'b0;
254       aw_valid     = 1'b0;
255       // `lock_aw_valid`, used to be protocol conform as it is not allowed to deassert
256       // a valid if there was no corresponding ready. As this process has to be able to inject
257       // an AXI ID into the counter of the AR channel on an ATOP, there could be a case where
258       // this process waits on `aw_ready` but in the mean time on the AR channel the counter gets
259       // full.
260       lock_aw_valid_d = lock_aw_valid_q;
261       load_aw_lock    = 1'b0;
262       // AW ID counter and W FIFO
263       aw_push      = 1'b0;
264       // ATOP injection into ar counter
265       atop_inject  = 1'b0;
266       // we had an arbitration decision, the valid is locked, wait for the transaction
267       if (lock_aw_valid_q) begin
268         aw_valid = 1'b1;
269         // transaction
270         if (aw_ready) begin
271           slv_aw_ready    = 1'b1;
272           lock_aw_valid_d = 1'b0;
273           load_aw_lock    = 1'b1;
274           // inject the ATOP if necessary
275           atop_inject     = slv_aw_chan_select.aw_chan.atop[axi_pkg::ATOP_R_RESP] & AtopSupport;
276         end
277       end else begin
278         // An AW can be handled if `i_aw_id_counter` and `i_w_fifo` are not full.  An ATOP that
279         // requires an R response can be handled if additionally `i_ar_id_counter` is not full (this
280         // only applies if ATOPs are supported at all).
281         if (!aw_id_cnt_full && !w_fifo_full &&
282             (!(ar_id_cnt_full && slv_aw_chan_select.aw_chan.atop[axi_pkg::ATOP_R_RESP]) ||
283              !AtopSupport)) begin
284           // there is a valid AW vector make the id lookup and go further, if it passes
285           if (slv_aw_valid && (!aw_select_occupied ||
286              (slv_aw_chan_select.aw_select == lookup_aw_select))) begin
287             // connect the handshake
288             aw_valid     = 1'b1;
289             // push arbitration to the W FIFO regardless, do not wait for the AW transaction
290             aw_push      = 1'b1;
291             // on AW transaction
292             if (aw_ready) begin
293               slv_aw_ready = 1'b1;
294               atop_inject  = slv_aw_chan_select.aw_chan.atop[axi_pkg::ATOP_R_RESP] & AtopSupport;
295             // no AW transaction this cycle, lock the decision
296             end else begin
297               lock_aw_valid_d = 1'b1;
298               load_aw_lock    = 1'b1;
299             end
300           end
301         end
302       end
303     end
304 
305     // lock the valid signal, as the selection gets pushed into the W FIFO on first assertion,
306     // prevent further pushing
307     `FFLARN(lock_aw_valid_q, lock_aw_valid_d, load_aw_lock, '0, clk_i, rst_ni)
308 
309     if (UniqueIds) begin : gen_unique_ids_aw
310       // If the `UniqueIds` parameter is set, each write transaction has an ID that is unique among
311       // all in-flight write transactions, or all write transactions with a given ID target the same
312       // master port as all write transactions with the same ID, or both.  This means that the
313       // signals that are driven by the ID counters if this parameter is not set can instead be
314       // derived from existing signals.  The ID counters can therefore be omitted.
315       assign lookup_aw_select = slv_aw_chan_select.aw_select;
316       assign aw_select_occupied = 1'b0;
317       assign aw_id_cnt_full = 1'b0;
318     end else begin : gen_aw_id_counter
319       axi_demux_id_counters #(
320         .AxiIdBits         ( AxiLookBits    ),
321         .CounterWidth      ( IdCounterWidth ),
322         .mst_port_select_t ( select_t       )
323       ) i_aw_id_counter (
324         .clk_i                        ( clk_i                                         ),
325         .rst_ni                       ( rst_ni                                        ),
326         .lookup_axi_id_i              ( slv_aw_chan_select.aw_chan.id[0+:AxiLookBits] ),
327         .lookup_mst_select_o          ( lookup_aw_select                              ),
328         .lookup_mst_select_occupied_o ( aw_select_occupied                            ),
329         .full_o                       ( aw_id_cnt_full                                ),
330         .inject_axi_id_i              ( '0                                            ),
331         .inject_i                     ( 1'b0                                          ),
332         .push_axi_id_i                ( slv_aw_chan_select.aw_chan.id[0+:AxiLookBits] ),
333         .push_mst_select_i            ( slv_aw_chan_select.aw_select                  ),
334         .push_i                       ( aw_push                                       ),
335         .pop_axi_id_i                 ( slv_b_chan.id[0+:AxiLookBits]                 ),
336         .pop_i                        ( slv_b_valid & slv_b_ready                     )
337       );
338       // pop from ID counter on outward transaction
339     end
340 
341     // FIFO to save W selection
342     fifo_v3 #(
343       .FALL_THROUGH ( FallThrough ),
344       .DEPTH        ( MaxTrans    ),
345       .dtype        ( select_t    )
346     ) i_w_fifo (
347       .clk_i     ( clk_i                        ),
348       .rst_ni    ( rst_ni                       ),
349       .flush_i   ( 1'b0                         ),
350       .testmode_i( test_i                       ),
351       .full_o    ( w_fifo_full                  ),
352       .empty_o   ( w_fifo_empty                 ),
353       .usage_o   (                              ),
354       .data_i    ( slv_aw_chan_select.aw_select ),
355       .push_i    ( aw_push                      ), // controlled from proc_aw_chan
356       .data_o    ( w_select                     ), // where the w beat should go
357       .pop_i     ( w_fifo_pop                   )  // controlled from proc_w_chan
358     );
359 
360     //--------------------------------------
361     //  W Channel
362     //--------------------------------------
363     spill_register #(
364       .T       ( w_chan_t ),
365       .Bypass  ( ~SpillW  )
366     ) i_w_spill_reg(
367       .clk_i   ( clk_i              ),
368       .rst_ni  ( rst_ni             ),
369       .valid_i ( slv_req_i.w_valid  ),
370       .ready_o ( slv_resp_o.w_ready ),
371       .data_i  ( slv_req_i.w        ),
372       .valid_o ( slv_w_valid        ),
373       .ready_i ( slv_w_ready        ),
374       .data_o  ( slv_w_chan         )
375     );
376 
377     //--------------------------------------
378     //  B Channel
379     //--------------------------------------
380     // optional spill register
381     spill_register #(
382       .T       ( b_chan_t ),
383       .Bypass  ( ~SpillB  )
384     ) i_b_spill_reg (
385       .clk_i   ( clk_i              ),
386       .rst_ni  ( rst_ni             ),
387       .valid_i ( slv_b_valid        ),
388       .ready_o ( slv_b_ready        ),
389       .data_i  ( slv_b_chan         ),
390       .valid_o ( slv_resp_o.b_valid ),
391       .ready_i ( slv_req_i.b_ready  ),
392       .data_o  ( slv_resp_o.b       )
393     );
394 
395     // Arbitration of the different B responses
396     rr_arb_tree #(
397       .NumIn    ( NoMstPorts ),
398       .DataType ( b_chan_t   ),
399       .AxiVldRdy( 1'b1       ),
400       .LockIn   ( 1'b1       )
401     ) i_b_mux (
402       .clk_i  ( clk_i         ),
403       .rst_ni ( rst_ni        ),
404       .flush_i( 1'b0          ),
405       .rr_i   ( '0            ),
406       .req_i  ( mst_b_valids  ),
407       .gnt_o  ( mst_b_readies ),
408       .data_i ( mst_b_chans   ),
409       .gnt_i  ( slv_b_ready   ),
410       .req_o  ( slv_b_valid   ),
411       .data_o ( slv_b_chan    ),
412       .idx_o  (               )
413     );
414 
415     //--------------------------------------
416     //  AR Channel
417     //--------------------------------------
418     // Workaround for bug in Questa (see comments on AW channel for details).
419     `ifdef TARGET_VSIM
420     typedef logic [$bits(ar_chan_select_t)-1:0] ar_chan_select_flat_t;
421     `else
422     typedef ar_chan_select_t ar_chan_select_flat_t;
423     `endif
424     ar_chan_select_flat_t slv_ar_chan_select_in_flat,
425                           slv_ar_chan_select_out_flat;
426     assign slv_ar_chan_select_in_flat = {slv_req_i.ar, slv_ar_select_i};
427     spill_register #(
428       .T       ( ar_chan_select_flat_t        ),
429       .Bypass  ( ~SpillAr                     )
430     ) i_ar_spill_reg (
431       .clk_i   ( clk_i                        ),
432       .rst_ni  ( rst_ni                       ),
433       .valid_i ( slv_req_i.ar_valid           ),
434       .ready_o ( slv_resp_o.ar_ready          ),
435       .data_i  ( slv_ar_chan_select_in_flat   ),
436       .valid_o ( slv_ar_valid                 ),
437       .ready_i ( slv_ar_ready                 ),
438       .data_o  ( slv_ar_chan_select_out_flat  )
439     );
440     assign slv_ar_chan_select = slv_ar_chan_select_out_flat;
441 
442     // control of the AR handshake
443     always_comb begin
444       // AXI Handshakes
445       slv_ar_ready    = 1'b0;
446       ar_valid        = 1'b0;
447       // `lock_ar_valid`: Used to be protocol conform as it is not allowed to deassert `ar_valid`
448       // if there was no corresponding `ar_ready`. There is the possibility that an injection
449       // of a R response from an `atop` from the AW channel can change the occupied flag of the
450       // `i_ar_id_counter`, even if it was previously empty. This FF prevents the deassertion.
451       lock_ar_valid_d = lock_ar_valid_q;
452       load_ar_lock    = 1'b0;
453       // AR id counter
454       ar_push         = 1'b0;
455       // The process had an arbitration decision in a previous cycle, the valid is locked,
456       // wait for the AR transaction.
457       if (lock_ar_valid_q) begin
458         ar_valid = 1'b1;
459         // transaction
460         if (ar_ready) begin
461           slv_ar_ready    = 1'b1;
462           ar_push         = 1'b1;
463           lock_ar_valid_d = 1'b0;
464           load_ar_lock    = 1'b1;
465         end
466       end else begin
467         // The process can start handling AR transaction if `i_ar_id_counter` has space.
468         if (!ar_id_cnt_full) begin
469           // There is a valid AR, so look the ID up.
470           if (slv_ar_valid && (!ar_select_occupied ||
471              (slv_ar_chan_select.ar_select == lookup_ar_select))) begin
472             // connect the AR handshake
473             ar_valid     = 1'b1;
474             // on transaction
475             if (ar_ready) begin
476               slv_ar_ready = 1'b1;
477               ar_push      = 1'b1;
478             // no transaction this cycle, lock the valid decision!
479             end else begin
480               lock_ar_valid_d = 1'b1;
481               load_ar_lock    = 1'b1;
482             end
483           end
484         end
485       end
486     end
487 
488     // this ff is needed so that ar does not get de-asserted if an atop gets injected
489     `FFLARN(lock_ar_valid_q, lock_ar_valid_d, load_ar_lock, '0, clk_i, rst_ni)
490 
491     if (UniqueIds) begin : gen_unique_ids_ar
492       // If the `UniqueIds` parameter is set, each read transaction has an ID that is unique among
493       // all in-flight read transactions, or all read transactions with a given ID target the same
494       // master port as all read transactions with the same ID, or both.  This means that the
495       // signals that are driven by the ID counters if this parameter is not set can instead be
496       // derived from existing signals.  The ID counters can therefore be omitted.
497       assign lookup_ar_select = slv_ar_chan_select.ar_select;
498       assign ar_select_occupied = 1'b0;
499       assign ar_id_cnt_full = 1'b0;
500     end else begin : gen_ar_id_counter
501       axi_demux_id_counters #(
502         .AxiIdBits         ( AxiLookBits    ),
503         .CounterWidth      ( IdCounterWidth ),
504         .mst_port_select_t ( select_t       )
505       ) i_ar_id_counter (
506         .clk_i                        ( clk_i                                         ),
507         .rst_ni                       ( rst_ni                                        ),
508         .lookup_axi_id_i              ( slv_ar_chan_select.ar_chan.id[0+:AxiLookBits] ),
509         .lookup_mst_select_o          ( lookup_ar_select                              ),
510         .lookup_mst_select_occupied_o ( ar_select_occupied                            ),
511         .full_o                       ( ar_id_cnt_full                                ),

656   parameter int unsigned AxiIdBits         = 2,
657   parameter int unsigned CounterWidth      = 4,
658   parameter type         mst_port_select_t = logic
659 ) (
660   input                        clk_i,   // Clock
661   input                        rst_ni,  // Asynchronous reset active low
662   // lookup
663   input  logic [AxiIdBits-1:0] lookup_axi_id_i,
664   output mst_port_select_t     lookup_mst_select_o,
665   output logic                 lookup_mst_select_occupied_o,
666   // push
667   output logic                 full_o,
668   input  logic [AxiIdBits-1:0] push_axi_id_i,
669   input  mst_port_select_t     push_mst_select_i,
670   input  logic                 push_i,
671   // inject ATOPs in AR channel
672   input  logic [AxiIdBits-1:0] inject_axi_id_i,
673   input  logic                 inject_i,
674   // pop
675   input  logic [AxiIdBits-1:0] pop_axi_id_i,
676   input  logic                 pop_i
677 );
678   localparam int unsigned NoCounters = 2**AxiIdBits;
679   typedef logic [CounterWidth-1:0] cnt_t;
680 
681   // registers, each gets loaded when push_en[i]
682   mst_port_select_t [NoCounters-1:0] mst_select_q;
683 
684   // counter signals
685   logic [NoCounters-1:0] push_en, inject_en, pop_en, occupied, cnt_full;
686 
687   //-----------------------------------
688   // Lookup
689   //-----------------------------------
690   assign lookup_mst_select_o          = mst_select_q[lookup_axi_id_i];
691   assign lookup_mst_select_occupied_o = occupied[lookup_axi_id_i];
692   //-----------------------------------
693   // Push and Pop
694   //-----------------------------------
695   assign push_en   = (push_i)   ? (1 << push_axi_id_i)   : '0;
696   assign inject_en = (inject_i) ? (1 << inject_axi_id_i) : '0;
697   assign pop_en    = (pop_i)    ? (1 << pop_axi_id_i)    : '0;
698   assign full_o    = |cnt_full;
699   // counters
700   for (genvar i = 0; i < NoCounters; i++) begin : gen_counters
701     logic cnt_en, cnt_down, overflow;
702     cnt_t cnt_delta, in_flight;
703     always_comb begin
704       unique case ({push_en[i], inject_en[i], pop_en[i]})
705         3'b001  : begin // pop_i = -1
706           cnt_en    = 1'b1;
707           cnt_down  = 1'b1;
708           cnt_delta = cnt_t'(1);
709         end
710         3'b010  : begin // inject_i = +1
711           cnt_en    = 1'b1;
712           cnt_down  = 1'b0;
713           cnt_delta = cnt_t'(1);
714         end
715      // 3'b011, inject_i & pop_i = 0 --> use default
716         3'b100  : begin // push_i = +1
717           cnt_en    = 1'b1;
718           cnt_down  = 1'b0;
719           cnt_delta = cnt_t'(1);
720         end
721      // 3'b101, push_i & pop_i = 0 --> use default
722         3'b110  : begin // push_i & inject_i = +2
723           cnt_en    = 1'b1;
724           cnt_down  = 1'b0;
725           cnt_delta = cnt_t'(2);
726         end
727         3'b111  : begin // push_i & inject_i & pop_i = +1
728           cnt_en    = 1'b1;
729           cnt_down  = 1'b0;
730           cnt_delta = cnt_t'(1);
731         end
732         default : begin // do nothing to the counters
733           cnt_en    = 1'b0;
734           cnt_down  = 1'b0;
735           cnt_delta = cnt_t'(0);
736         end
737       endcase
738     end
